context: Goro-grandpa teaches Sho-child how to fish at the small river.
purpose: Grandfather figure teaching child outdoor skill patiently.

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.jp: 釣りはな、静かに待つんや。
lines.style: Quiet, unhurried opening. Soft weight on each word. Patient, teaching tone that expects nothing but listening. The voice of someone who has stood by water many times and knows what matters.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Bright immediate burst of commitment. Small chest, full heart. The energy of a child who trusts the older person and wants to do it right. Slight catch of eagerness — will he be good enough?

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.jp: 魚が来るまで、川を見てな。
lines.en: Watch the river till one comes.
lines.style: Slow, measured instruction. Each phrase lands like a stepping stone. No rush. The voice of someone teaching something true and simple: waiting is the whole point, not the price.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Soft upward lift at the end — genuine wondering, not performance. Whisper-small. The question of someone who trusts the answer but needs to hear it. Slight tremor of hope underneath.

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.jp: 焦らんでええ、ゆっくりや。
lines.en: No need to rush — take it slow.
lines.style: Warm reassurance, settling. Emphasize 「焦らん」 with gentle firmness. The tone of someone saying: this is how we live, this is enough. Not lecturing — just speaking from long knowing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: おじいちゃん、優しいね。
lines.style: Struck by sudden noticing. Soft, unguarded. Not performing gratitude — actually surprised by gentleness. Voice bright with small discovery. A child saying something true before he can stop himself.

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.jp: ふふ、おまえも優しなれ。
lines.en: Heh — you grow up kind too.
lines.style: Quiet laugh, barely there. The warm knowing of someone looking ahead without saying so. Soft, even tone. A blessing that sounds like a simple wish. No pressure — just faith.
